note: Worked example. Every feature the format has is used at least once here, so this file doubles as the reference for writing the rest.

choices.say: Santi. The fat one in the hold. He has opinions.
What is in the pot, Santi?
Your grandmother. Sporca. Was she a cook or a punishment?

lines.text: Opinions! A man eats for free and reviews the galley.
He says my rat's tail is the worst he has tasted. Of all the galleys. He has a list, Captain. He keeps a list.
A critic. How novel. Most of my prisoners only scream.
Yesterday it was also soup. Same soup, different scum.
My nonna Sporca fed nine children and two husbands on one goat.
The second husband asked what happened to the goat.
He also asked what happened to the first husband.
